name: qfactory
description: Find a QFactory workflow for your task and run it locally with Q-Core. Self-contained skill; the read-only catalog MCP serves data only.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your task into a checked workflow result.
interface.longDescription: Find a relevant workflow from the current catalog. Explain the result before setup, then run the accepted plan locally through Q-Core.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use QFactory to find a workflow for my task.
